neighbours.label: English tabletop role-playing rulebook text: character traits, Merits/Flaws, bonuses and rolls in game-mechanics language (the same words in everyday senses stay low; plain dice gambling fires only weakly)
fire: A character with the Iron Stomach Merit gains a +2 bonus on Stamina rolls to resist poison.
The Flaw Nightmares costs 1 point and forces a Willpower roll each morning to avoid a -1 penalty to all dice pools.
Add your Dexterity rating to your Athletics trait when rolling to dodge, then subtract the target's Defense.
Characters who purchase the Ambidextrous Merit ignore the usual off-hand penalty on attack rolls.
On a botch, the Storyteller may impose a temporary Derangement that lasts until the end of the scene.
Each dot of Resources beyond the third grants an additional bonus die on Social rolls involving bribery.
The Disfigured Flaw reduces your Appearance trait to zero and imposes a two-dice penalty on Persuasion rolls.
Make a Wits + Awareness roll at difficulty 7; three or more successes reveal the ambush.
quiet: At the casino he rolled the dice and lost on craps.
The wizard cast a fireball spell that burned the village to the ground.
She ate a bread roll and drank coffee before the morning meeting at the office.
His employer paid him a holiday bonus of two hundred dollars this December.
The judge praised the merits of the argument but found a flaw in the evidence.
Patience is one of her best character traits, according to her old teachers.
The truck rolled slowly down the hill after the brakes failed.
Each extra hour of practice gave the pianist more confidence before the concert.
